When brothers and sisters bump hard

A table read for the middle of the mess—pairs with Peacemakers.

Read-aloud

Sometimes the same room holds two big feelings at once—mine and yours, both loud. Jesus does not ask us to pretend nothing happened. He blesses the ones who help peace grow instead of letting the fight win.

Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God. Matthew 5:9 (KJV)

A peacemaker might pause, say sorry first, or ask a grown-up for help. Little steps count. God sees them.

Gentle question

What is one small thing we could do right now to help peace instead of winning the argument?

Short prayer together

Lord, when we bump hard, help us be peacemakers. Make us kind like Your children. Amen.

Coloring idea

Two chairs at a table, hands open instead of crossed, a small dove or heart between them. Verse Image → Open Bible at the table (T16).
